title: Open ADEP: Open AI Decision Evidence Protocol (Phase 0 Specifications and Schemas, v0.2.0-phase0)
description: Open, vendor-neutral specification and JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) suite for verifiable decision evidence packages in AI-assisted healthcare workflows, initially targeting prior authorization (PA). Defines healthcare decision-reconstruction semantics (binding clinical records, coverage policy versions, AI model inputs/outputs/identifications, human clinical review attestations, and adverse determination/appeal records), cross-organization evidence graphs with 10 trust-model roles and boundary-preserving privacy commitments, and independent verification separating cryptographic integrity (P-1/P-2) from scope completeness (P-5).
